dedupe_keys.name: graph database of the urban road network of modena

description: The anonymous depositor publishes a Modena road database derived from OpenStreetMap. Zenodo exposes a Neo4j dump and a GraphML export free under CC BY 4.0. Both primal and dual road graphs are represented, alongside traffic-volume information and points of interest. The description links a code repository for graph analysis, routing and road-closure scenarios, while a note explains Neo4j import. These prepared relationships can support road-network disruption simulations. Related catalogue record data-openstreetmap identifies the upstream map source. Coverage is Modena, Italy; extraction dates, traffic measurement periods and attribute definitions remain unknown. The anonymous code page was inaccessible in the web reader, so software compatibility was not confirmed. Neo4j dump versions and source mapping licence obligations require attention before reuse. No database was downloaded, imported or checked for topological and traffic consistency.
